note.en: The coffeebean trivia, a ribbed brown shell about 1.5 cm that lives under rocks and feeds on sea squirts; seven INBio specimens.
note.es: La trivia grano de café, una concha acostillada café de unos 1,5 cm que vive bajo rocas y se alimenta de ascidias; siete especímenes de INBio.

evidence: GBIF: 7 records in the region (mostly museum specimens)
